29.speaker: Napoleon
29.en: What do you mean, what's with it? I'm quitting. This work's too dangerous. I think someone's after me. I'll be killed just like Gibson.
cards: What do you mean,|what's with it? I'm quitting.

2a.speaker: Napoleon
2a.en: I've had enough. Let's call it quits.
cards: I've had enough.|Let's call it quits.

2b.speaker: Gillian
2b.en: Wait, Napoleon. I'll protect you from the Snatchers.
cards: Wait, Napoleon.|I'll protect you|from the Snatchers.

2c.speaker: Napoleon
2c.en: We're both targets. Watch out for the Snatchers.
cards: We're both targets.|Watch out for the Snatchers.

2d.speaker: Napoleon
2d.en: Here, take this. A Christmas present.

31.speaker: Gillian
31.en: Can't blame him for being scared. We got the answers we needed, anyway.
cards: Can't blame him for|being scared. We|got the answers we|needed, anyway.

32.speaker: Metal Gear
32.en: There's an ad on the back of the tissues.

33.speaker: Gillian

cards: An ad for Outer|Heaven! He does|this too?

36.speaker: Metal Gear
36.en: No seats free. We'll have to wait a little.
cards: No seats free.|We'll have to wait|a little.

37.speaker: Cook
37.en: Seats open! Come on in! Welcome!

38.speaker: Metal Gear
38.en: Looks like a seat opened up. Let's go.
cards: Looks like a seat|opened up. Let's go.

40.speaker: Gillian
40.en: My wife used to say I ate a lot.
cards: My wife used to say|I ate a lot.

41.speaker: Metal Gear
41.en: Gillian, hurry up and eat. We should go.
cards: Gillian, hurry up|and eat. We should|go.

42.speaker: Gillian
42.en: Come on, hurry. Come on. Ah, that was good. All right. Let's go.
cards: Come on, hurry.|Come on. Ah, that|was good. All|right. Let's go.

43.speaker: Teller
43.en: You again! I knew you'd come back.
cards: You again! I knew|you'd come back.

45.speaker: Teller
45.en: Coming back proves you believe me. What is it today?
cards: Coming back proves|you believe me.|What is it today?

47.speaker: Teller
47.en: Who? Do you have a photo, a retinal pattern, an ID, anything?
cards: Who? Do you have a|photo, a retinal|pattern, an ID,|anything?

48.speaker: Metal Gear
48.en: I have her data. I'll transfer it to your terminal.
cards: I have her data.|I'll transfer it to|your terminal.

4a.speaker: Teller
4a.en: Got it. Catherine, is it? Let me read her fortune.
cards: Got it. Catherine,|is it? Let me read|her fortune.

4e.speaker: Teller
4e.en: Right near you. She's very close.

52.speaker: Teller
52.en: Would you believe me if I put it this way? A few hours ago, this girl used a public terminal near your apartment. There's a record of it.
cards: Would you believe|me if I put it this|way?
this girl used a|public terminal|near your|apartment.

53.speaker: Metal Gear
53.en: Could that be when Catherine called headquarters?

54.speaker: Gillian
54.en: Where did you get that information?

56.speaker: Gillian
56.en: I'm impressed. Better informed than headquarters!

57.speaker: Teller
57.en: Fortune telling is all in the mind! Hmph! Come again!
cards: Fortune telling is|all in the mind!|Hmph! Come again!

58.speaker: Gillian
58.en: Some fortune teller. She's a hacker selling information!

59.speaker: Metal Gear
59.en: She may be more reliable than Napoleon.

d4.speaker: Napoleon
d4.en: Ah, hey, now! Excuse me! Heh heh heh...
cards: Ah, hey, now! Excuse|me! Heh heh heh...
